mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_log (app_name, log_level, trace_id, content, create_time) VALUES (#{appName}, #{logLevel}, #{traceId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, app_name, log_level, trace_id, content, create_time FROM sys_log WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, app_name, log_level, trace_id, content, create_time FROM sys_log WHERE id BETWEEN (#{id} - #{before}) AND (#{id} + #{after}) ORDER BY id ASC
